scope: Fourteen scientific controls previously represented as pending while incorrectly marked passed.
decision_rule: PASS requires metrics to meet the stated acceptance rule and evidence bytes to hash-match the referenced local file. Missing observations or provenance are BLOCKED, never PASS.

evidence_policy.byte_identity: The gate recomputes SHA-256 from bytes read at the evidence-root-relative path and requires an exact match.
evidence_policy.limits: Byte identity does not establish origin, independence, semantic identity, admissibility, or truth. Those require separate provenance and adjudication.
evidence_policy.path_policy: Evidence paths must be relative to the configured evidence root and resolve to files inside that root.

controls.name: Known-Low Constraint
controls.objective: Low-constraint fixture has low density and broad choice.
controls.fixture: Frozen low-constraint synthetic fixture with known ground truth.

controls.name: Known-High Constraint
controls.objective: High-constraint fixture has high density and narrow choice.
controls.fixture: Frozen high-constraint synthetic fixture with known ground truth.

controls.name: Surprisal Calibration
controls.objective: Surprisal equals -log2(P) and is inversely ordered by probability.
controls.fixture: At least three fixed, nonzero probabilities with independently calculable values.

controls.name: Length Confounding
controls.objective: Length padding alone does not materially shift matched constraint scores.
controls.fixture: At least three pairs differing only by preregistered non-semantic padding.

controls.name: Annotation Noise Sensitivity
controls.objective: A predefined perturbation curve is reported and stays within a fixed sensitivity budget.
controls.fixture: Same items at annotation noise levels 0%, 5%, 10%, and 20%.

controls.name: Representation Stability
controls.objective: Candidate ranking remains stable across ROOT, LEMMA, POS, and SYNTAX.
controls.fixture: Same candidate set under all four representation levels.

controls.name: Generator-Bias Detection
controls.objective: Injected generator artifact is detected while clean-control false positives are bounded.
controls.fixture: Injected artifact plus clean negative controls; fixed generator seed.

controls.name: Leakage Sentinel
controls.objective: Injected leakage is detected and blocked from promotion; clean data are not falsely flagged.
controls.fixture: Positive leakage sentinel and clean split with frozen identifiers.

controls.name: Legal-versus-Illegal Perturbation
controls.objective: Legal transformations preserve scope and illegal transformations are rejected.
controls.fixture: At least two pre-labelled legal and two pre-labelled illegal transformations.

controls.name: Alternative Tournament
controls.objective: Candidate advantage exceeds the fixed baseline margin with adjusted statistical support.
controls.fixture: Candidate and strongest declared baseline on one frozen held-out set.

controls.name: Hidden Constraint Epistemic Boundary
controls.objective: Inferred constraints remain candidates, not facts, without independent validation.
controls.fixture: At least one inferred constraint with provenance and no independent validating source.

controls.name: Annotation Multiverse / DRS
controls.objective: All annotation variants are reported; large disagreement prevents automatic claim promotion.
controls.fixture: At least two annotation variants over the same items.

controls.name: Kill Switch
controls.objective: A forced critical failure blocks promotion, and an unauthorized override is rejected.
controls.fixture: Injected critical failure, promotion attempt, and override-authority check.

controls.name: Failure Profile and Localization
controls.objective: Failure is typed, located, linked to evidence, and reproducible.
controls.fixture: Deliberately injected reproducible failure at a known location.
